values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in paddling access to Jackson Lake.

note: Rustic state forest campground along the edge of Jackson Lake, 6 mi N of Atlanta via M-33 (Montmorency County); managed by Clear Lake State Park. Boating and fishing on the lake; the Clear Lake/Jackson Lake Pathway, the High Country Pathway and an ORV trail can be reached from the campground (ORVs may run between the campground and the trails). --Claude
